title: Hearty Jamaican Pork Bake
description: A rich and juicy Jamaican dish featuring minced pork, baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven, halal-friendly and served in a lazy-susan-spinner vessel.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the minced pork, chopped onion, seeded and chopped scotch bonnet pepper, minced garlic, dried thyme, ground allspice, salt, black pepper, and pimento.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Transfer the mixture to a lazy-susan-spinner vessel.
Sprinkle the wood-fired-bake seasoning over the top of the pork mixture.
Bake the pork mixture in the preheated wood-fired oven for 30 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the pork bake from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
